preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.
At least 2 minutes must have passed since the last call to the lunaburn function, checked via the `lastSync` public variable.
The liquidity pool pair contract must hold a non-zero balance of the LUNAINU token.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `lunaburn(uint256 percent_base1000)` function with `percent_base1000` set to its maximum allowed value of 50. This action transfers 5% of the total LUNAINU tokens from the liquidity pool pair contract directly to the owner's address. The exploit can be repeated every 2 minutes to progressively drain the liquidity.
